description: For proactive and autonomous modes: track session health from multiple independent signals rather than a single metric (e.g. just time elapsed). Signals: observation count, session length, topic depth, compaction proximity, unanswered Socratic threads. Multi-signal avoids single-metric failure modes — a single metric gets gamed or fails silently. Modeled on Storybloq's context-pressure.ts with configurable thresholds.
title: Multi-signal session health — compute pressure from independent signals
